passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I go shopping with my mom.
phrases.py: wǒ hé mā mā yì qǐ qù gòu wù。
wǒ men yǒu yī zhāng qīng dān。
wǒ men tiāo xuǎn shuǐ guǒ huó miàn bāo。
wǒ bāng máng ná dài zi。
wǒ men kuài lè de huí jiā。

phrases.en: The list helps us choose only what we need.
phrases.zh: 清单帮助我们只挑选需要的东西。
phrases.py: qīng dān bāng zhù wǒ men zhǐ tiāo xuǎn xū yào de dōng xī。

phrases.en: Fruit and bread are at the top of the list.
phrases.ko: 과일과 빵은 목록의 맨 위에 있어요.
phrases.zh: 水果和面包在清单的最上面。
phrases.py: shuǐ guǒ huó miàn bāo zài qīng dān de zuì shàng miàn。

phrases.en: I help Mom, and then she will pay.
phrases.ko: 나는 엄마를 돕고, 그다음에 엄마가 값을 낼 거예요.
phrases.zh: 我帮妈妈，然后她会付钱。
phrases.py: wǒ bāng mā mā， rán hòu tā huì fù qián。

phrases.en: A full bag means we can go home and cook.
phrases.ko: 가득한 봉지는 우리가 집에 가서 요리할 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.zh: 袋子满了，就说明我们可以回家做饭了。
phrases.py: dài zi mǎn le， jiù shuō míng wǒ men kě yǐ huí jiā zuò fàn le。

full_passage_lines.en: I go shopping with my mom.
The list helps us choose only what we need.
Fruit and bread are at the top of the list.
full_passage_lines.ko: 과일과 빵은 목록의 맨 위에 있어요.

full_passage_lines.en: I help Mom, and then she will pay.
full_passage_lines.ko: 나는 엄마를 돕고, 그다음에 엄마가 값을 낼 거예요.

full_passage_lines.en: A full bag means we can go home and cook.
full_passage_lines.ko: 가득한 봉지는 우리가 집에 가서 요리할 수 있다는 뜻이에요.

full_passage_spoken: I go shopping with my mom. We have a list. We choose fruit and bread. Mom will pay. The bag is full. I help hold the bag. We go home happy. The list helps us choose only what we need. Fruit and bread are at the top of the list. I help Mom, and then she will pay. A full bag means we can go home and cook.
full_passage_zh: 我和妈妈一起去购物。我们有一张清单。我们挑选水果和面包。妈妈会付钱。袋子满了。我帮忙拿袋子。我们快乐地回家。清单帮助我们只挑选需要的东西。水果和面包在清单的最上面。我帮妈妈，然后她会付钱。袋子满了，就说明我们可以回家做饭了。
full_passage_pinyin: wǒ hé mā mā yì qǐ qù gòu wù。 wǒ men yǒu yī zhāng qīng dān。 wǒ men tiāo xuǎn shuǐ guǒ huó miàn bāo。 mā mā huì fù qián。 dài zi mǎn le。 wǒ bāng máng ná dài zi。 wǒ men kuài lè de huí jiā。 qīng dān bāng zhù wǒ men zhǐ tiāo xuǎn xū yào de dōng xī。 shuǐ guǒ huó miàn bāo zài qīng dān de zuì shàng miàn。 wǒ bāng mā mā， rán hòu tā huì fù qián。 dài zi mǎn le， jiù shuō míng wǒ men kě yǐ huí jiā zuò fàn le。
